name: th_accounting
title: Thailand accounting starter (VAT 7%, tax invoices, credit/debit notes, WHT)
description: Sales order to tax invoice, ledger, payment and reconciliation for one Thai company, built on generic primitives. Not a statutory-compliance claim: no e-Tax Invoice, P.P.30 / P.N.D. filings, WHT certificates or Thai PDF layout.
